extDesc.message: Shows a reading line at your cursor to help you keep your place and reduce skipped lines.

onboardingTitle.message: The reading line is off on first open

onboardingBody.message: That is expected. Keep the page you want to read open, then select On in this panel.

onboardingStepPage.message: Open this popup from the tab where you want to use the reading line.

onboardingStepOn.message: You can adjust settings later. Select On below to start.

onboardingNextStep.message: First step: select the On button below to get started.

onboardingTip.message: Tip: after it appears, the line follows your mouse. You can also move it in small steps with Shift+Alt+Up/Down.

presetKeyboardHelp.message: Use the arrow, Home, and End keys to select a preset color.

labelAutoOn.message: Turn on automatically for this site

trialRemainingMany.message: $DAYS$ days left in your free trial (until $DATE$).

statusFirstUseEmpty.message: The reading line is off on first open. Select On on the page you want to read to show it.

statusLineShown.message: Reading line is on. Use Shift+Alt+Up/Down to move it with the keyboard.

statusUnavailable.message: The reading line is not available on this page.
